title: Pullback coherence for coefficient realization and its normalized endpoints
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be an arbitrary scheme morphism with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes. Use the actual coefficient towers $R_T=(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})_T$ and $A_T=(\mathcal O_E/\ell^{n+1})_T$, their ordinary derived module categories, and normalized Chern construction data $c_Y,c_X$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern]. Let $P=f^*_{A,\bullet}$ be the geometric inverse image of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]. Let $\theta_0$ be its coefficient-unit comparison [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal], and $\theta_1$ its root-tensor line comparison [def-sp-tower-class-pullback], with their section normalizations. Let $F$ be componentwise abelian inverse image and let $z,a$ be the integer and shifted full-units comparisons [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback]. Define $H_T$ to be the composite of the recorded derived integral reduction and scalar extension to $A_T$. Let $s_T:H_T(\mathbf Z_\bullet)\simeq A_T$ be the composite unit identification, and $t_T:H_T(G_T[1])\to A_T(1)[2]$ the recorded root identification followed by the scalar shift and universal counit comparison. There is a natural transformation $\eta:H_Y P\to F H_X$ such that $\eta_{\mathbf Z} H_X(z) s_X=P(s_Y)\theta_0$ and $\eta_{G_Y[1]}H_X(a)t_X=P(t_Y)\operatorname{shift}_P(2)\theta_1[2]$. Here expressions are in left-to-right composition order; no line bundle, integral class or Chern arrow is part of this assertion. These are equations in the derived category of whole systems.

theorem tower_chernRealization_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) (_hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (_nY : cY.Normalized l E) (_nX : cX.Normalized l E)
    (θ₀ : CoefficientPullback l E b f g) (θ₁ : LinePullback l E f g cY cX) :
    ∃ η : chernRealization l E cY ⋙ SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g ⟶
        (abPull f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ chernRealization l E cX,
      η.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab Y) 0).obj (integers Y)) ≫
          (chernRealization l E cX).map (integerDerivedPull f) ≫
          (chernSource l E cX).hom =
        (SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g).map (chernSource l E cY).hom ≫
          (θ₀.derivedIso l E).hom ∧
      η.app (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab Y) 0).obj (units Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
          (chernRealization l E cX).map (unitsDerivedPull f) ≫ chernTarget l E cX =
        (SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g).map (chernTarget l E cY) ≫
          ((SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g).commShiftIso (2 : ℤ)).hom.app (line l E cY) ≫
          ((θ₁.derivedIso l E).hom)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧'
